en.title: Minimum Start Value
en.description:
Given an integer array, find the smallest positive initial value x such that, when the elements are added from left to right, every prefix sum is at least 1.

This site's input protocol and the explicitly stated supplementary ranges are compiled by CSWork and do not pose as the original OA rules.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000); the second line contains n integers arr[i] (−10^6..10^6).
en.output: Output the smallest valid initial value x.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Compute the minimum of all prefix sums, minPrefix. The initial value x must satisfy x+minPrefix≥1, so the answer is 1−minPrefix.
